Documents.description: Configures how the documents managed by the document managers (e.g. site settings, content definitions) are cached and synchronized, shared by all document types.

CheckConcurrency.description: Whether to check for concurrent updates when a document is saved, failing the update if the stored document was changed in the meantime.

CheckConsistency.description: Whether to check, after a document is cached, that it is still the last stored one, and to invalidate the cache otherwise.

SynchronizationLatency.description: When using a distributed cache, how long the identifier of a cached document is kept locally before being checked against the distributed cache again, in the 'hh:mm:ss' format.

FailoverRetryLatency.description: When the distributed cache fails, how long to wait before trying to use it again, in the 'hh:mm:ss' format.

CompressThreshold.description: The size in bytes from which a serialized document is compressed before being stored in the distributed cache.

LockTimeout.description: The timeout in milliseconds to acquire the lock used by an atomic update of a volatile document.

LockExpiration.description: The expiration in milliseconds of the lock used by an atomic update of a volatile document.

AbsoluteExpiration.description: The absolute date and time at which cached documents expire, e.g. '2030-01-01T00:00:00Z'.

AbsoluteExpirationRelativeToNow.description: The time, relative to now, after which cached documents expire, in the 'd.hh:mm:ss' format.

SlidingExpiration.description: How long a cached document can be inactive before it expires, in the 'd.hh:mm:ss' format.

Shells.description: Configures where the tenants settings and configuration are stored.

Database.description: Configures the Database Shells Configuration provider, which stores the tenants settings and configuration in a database. Enabled with 'AddDatabaseShellsConfiguration()'. Read from the application configuration only, not per tenant. See https://docs.orchardcore.net/en/latest/reference/modules/Shells/.

DatabaseProvider.description: The database provider: 'Sqlite', 'SqlConnection' (SQL Server), 'MySql' or 'Postgres'. Required.

ConnectionString.description: The database connection string. The database must exist before it is used by the provider.

TablePrefix.description: The prefix of the database tables.

Schema.description: The database schema of the tables.

MigrateFromFiles.description: Whether to migrate the existing tenants settings and configuration from the 'App_Data' folder to the database when they are not found in the database.

OrchardCore_Documents.deprecationMessage: The 'OrchardCore_Documents' section is deprecated. Use 'OrchardCore:Documents' instead.

OrchardCore_Shells_Database.deprecationMessage: The 'OrchardCore_Shells_Database' section is deprecated. Use 'OrchardCore:Shells:Database' instead.
